name: Python (CPython)
purpose: Domain API, geometry worker, kernel, tests
main_capabilities: numpy/scipy ecosystem; mature test tooling (pytest, hypothesis)
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Interpreter loops slow; vectorised numpy and JIT/compiled extensions needed for inner loops [N]
limitations: GIL (irrelevant: one job per process); numpy 2.5 and scipy 1.18 require Python ≥ 3.12 (PyPI requires_python)
dependency_risks: Version pin must match wheel availability of manifold3d, vtk, open3d (TQ-09)
rationale: Team skill; scientific stack; ADR-002

name: C++ (17/20)
purpose: Native kernels if Python/numba is too slow
limitations: Build complexity, memory-unsafe parsing of untrusted files (D-08), slower test loop
compatibility_with_architecture: Possible as an isolated extension module inside the worker
dependency_risks: Toolchain, ABI, wheels for target platforms
rationale: Introduce only if numba path fails measured budgets

name: TypeScript + Next.js + React
limitations: Must not own domain rules (ADR-004)
rationale: Owner decision DEC-010

name: numpy
licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
main_capabilities: ndarray, linalg (LAPACK), structured dtypes for binary parsing
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Vectorised C loops; BLAS threading must be pinned to 1 for determinism (ADR-010)
limitations: Python ≥ 3.12
dependency_risks: Upgrades may change floating-point results → regression (FN-OPS-04)
rationale: Baseline dependency

name: scipy
limitations: Some routines multi-threaded (pin threads)
rationale: Baseline dependency

name: numba
purpose: Compile BVH traversal, exact predicates, triangle tests
main_capabilities: nopython JIT, explicit loops at native speed
limitations: fastmath must stay off; parallel=False for determinism; LLVM version coupling
dependency_risks: Large dependency (llvmlite); JIT warm-up time; reproducibility across CPUs (X-06)
rationale: Decided by X-06 (determinism, warm-up) vs C++ extension

name: trimesh
main_capabilities: STL/OBJ/PLY/3MF/GLB I/O, sections, proximity, graph utilities, Boolean delegation
supported_formats: STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, GLB/GLTF, 3MF, others
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Mostly vectorised numpy; proximity uses R-tree candidates [N]
limitations: Default processing merges vertices (process=False needed); Booleans delegated to engines; behaviour changes across major versions (now 5.x)
compatibility_with_architecture: Oracle in tests (TC-FR-010 independent parser); optional utilities
dependency_risks: Major version 5 released recently — API drift vs 07 assumption (4.x) [H]
function_ids: FN-OPS-07; oracle for FN-KIO-01…05, FN-KMS-01, FN-KAN-01
rationale: Keep production path dependency-light; use as independent oracle

name: manifold3d (Manifold)
purpose: Robust Booleans, level-set offsets, manifold validation
main_capabilities: Union/difference/intersection with guaranteed manifold output; SDF level set; Python and WASM (npm manifold-3d 3.5.5)
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Parallel C++ by default [N]; must run single-threaded for determinism [H]
limitations: Input must be manifold; vertex merging rules internal
compatibility_with_architecture: Worker; not needed by MVP closure option A
dependency_risks: Active project with frequent releases; pin
rationale: No MVP Boolean (closure option A); keep for fixture blocks / shell

name: VTK
purpose: Windowed-sinc smoothing, QEM decimation, off-screen rendering
main_capabilities: vtkWindowedSincPolyDataFilter, vtkQuadricDecimation, vtkFillHolesFilter, vtkCutter, off-screen OSMesa/EGL rendering
supported_formats: STL, PLY, OBJ, VTP and many more
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Compiled C++; some filters multi-threaded via SMP tools [N]
limitations: Large wheel; pipeline API; determinism of filters to verify (X-01)
rationale: Use only if X-01 shows determinism and the SOUP cost is accepted; else own implementations

name: PyVista
main_capabilities: Mesh I/O, filters via VTK, off-screen plotting
limitations: Adds a layer over VTK; plotting stack heavy
compatibility_with_architecture: Development visualisation; not needed in production
rationale: Debug visualisation of fixtures only

name: ITK
main_capabilities: Image filters, segmentation, registration; mesh support limited
limitations: Image-centric; no surface-scan workflow need in MVP (input is optical surface scans, not CT)
function_ids: — (possible post-MVP if CT input is ever scoped)
rationale: No volumetric input in scope (DEC-009 import-only surface scans)

name: Open3D
purpose: Ray casting / closest point scene, ICP, reconstruction
main_capabilities: RaycastingScene (Embree-backed), ICP, Poisson reconstruction, mesh filters
limitations: Large wheel; thread pinning needed for determinism [H]; arm64 coverage to check
rationale: Decided by X-01 against libigl and own BVH

name: CGAL (PMP, Alpha Wrap, corefinement)
version_checked: 6.1.x (Debian 6.1.1 packaging seen); Python SWIG bindings 6.0.1 on PyPI
licence: GPL-3.0+ for most algorithm packages, LGPL-3.0+ for kernel/support; commercial licence from GeometryFactory
purpose: Exact predicates/constructions, self-intersection, hole filling, remeshing, Booleans
main_capabilities: Polygon Mesh Processing, Alpha Wrap, isotropic remeshing, corefinement
limitations: GPL packages not shippable under ADR-011 without commercial licence (OQ-G5)
rationale: Gold-standard oracle; commercial path if own detector fails X-02

name: libigl (Python bindings "libigl")
licence: MPL-2.0 (core); include/igl/copyleft/* under GPL/AGPL of wrapped libraries
purpose: AABB closest point, signed distance, geodesics, curvature
main_capabilities: point_mesh_squared_distance, signed_distance (pseudonormal/winding), exact geodesics, cotangent Laplacian
limitations: Must avoid copyleft namespace; Python API coverage varies by version
rationale: Decided by X-01; MPL-2.0 is on the ADR-011 allow-list

name: Gmsh
limitations: GPL; FE meshing not needed (no simulation in scope)
rationale: GPL and no FE simulation requirement

name: Open CASCADE Technology (via cadquery-ocp / pythonocc-core)
version_checked: OCCT 8.0.1 (2026-07-30, Wikipedia infobox); cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0 on PyPI
licence: LGPL-2.1-only WITH OCCT-exception-1.0 (cadquery-ocp wheel metadata: Apache-2.0 for bindings)
purpose: B-Rep modelling, STEP/IGES, thick solids, fillets
main_capabilities: Exact B-Rep Booleans, offsets, fillets, STEP export
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Heavy for scan meshes converted to faceted B-Rep (05 §4.1)
limitations: Scan → faceted B-Rep not editable; huge models
compatibility_with_architecture: Not needed for positive-mould STL MVP
function_ids: — (post-MVP shell fillets/STEP only if production needs it)
rationale: Mesh-native workflow; STEP not required (DEC-011)

name: Qt 6 (PySide6 / PyQt6)
licence: PySide6: LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0/3.0; PyQt6: GPL-3.0-only (commercial from vendor); Qt: LGPLv3/GPL/commercial
limitations: MVP is a web app (DEC-010); desktop distribution and updates out of scope
compatibility_with_architecture: Not compatible with chosen web architecture
rationale: DEC-010 web app; revisit only for an offline desktop edition

name: PyMeshLab
limitations: GPL
rationale: Second independent oracle for distance/hole filling

name: MeshLib SDK
licence: LicenseRef-MeshLib: free for non-commercial/educational use; commercial licence required for business use
main_capabilities: Full mesh toolkit incl. self-intersection repair, offsets
performance_characteristics_not_benchmar: Vendor claims high performance (vendor source G-SRC-25, not verified)
limitations: Commercial licence and cost; not open source
rationale: Commercial licence needed for clinic use; revisit with OQ-G5 only if own algorithms fail

name: Intel Embree (Python: embreex)
licence: Apache-2.0 (Embree); embreex wrapper BSD-style (copyright notice in PyPI metadata — verify)

name: fast-simplification
limitations: Limited topology controls [N]

name: meshoptimizer
limitations: Python binding alpha; display-only use
